remarks: Turnkey investment property in downtown Greenwich. Strong long term tenants in place. Rent $11,500/m (5.63 Cap) ending in May 2026. Extremely attractive for renters; prime location and townhome that lives like a single family home. Just seconds to Greenwich Ave, private/public schools, & hospital. Pristine 3 bed (possibly 4)/2.5 bath, 9 ft ceilings, crown molding, & hardwood floors. Rare and very desirable 2 car garage and large outdoor space. Finished lower level with radiant floors & fireplace. Expansive 2nd level with 3 bed/2 bath. Primary suite with huge walk in closet & luxury bath. Other two beds share en suite bath with double vanities. Truly a lucrative turnkey investment.
